Confused, you take the package inside and open it. Only to find an unusual smartphone and glasses inside. Inside the smartphone, you find a "Reality Porn App", claiming to allow you to hypnotize anyone you want by simply taking their picture. Despite such a surreal concept, you're tempted to give it a try...What do you do?*
